me.name: Aqsa Zamzami
me.tagline: I build clean, fast, and thoughtful web & mobile experiences, from pixel-level UI to resilient backends.
bio: I'm a software engineer who enjoys turning complicated problems into simple, well-crafted products. My work spans the whole stack: interfaces, APIs, databases, and the glue between them.
Outside of code I explore game UI design, which heavily inspires how this portfolio looks and feels.

projects.title: PRIME
projects.desc: Industrial predictive maintenance monorepo platform featuring real-time telemetry processing, automated machine failure forecasting, and semantic document retrieval.
projects.contribution: Architected microservices monorepo orchestration, integrated Python ML pipeline with Qdrant vector search, and configured TimescaleDB & Redis caching.

projects.title: Ardana
projects.desc: Cooperative savings, loans, and financial administration system built with modern reactive server-driven architecture and real-time ledger accounting.
projects.contribution: Developed fullstack modules using Laravel 12 and Inertia.js React 19, implemented financial transaction integrity, and styled UI with Tailwind CSS v4.

projects.title: ShareThem
projects.desc: High-speed offline peer-to-peer file transfer mobile app utilizing local area network device discovery and direct socket data streaming.
projects.contribution: Engineered zero-configuration mDNS service discovery via Bonsoir, optimized chunked TCP/UDP socket streaming, and built reactive Flutter UI.

projects.title: Expasign
projects.desc: Comprehensive competition & exhibition registration portal featuring automated payment verification via Saweria Webhook and ticket generation.
projects.contribution: Implemented backend API, designed automated payment verification webhook pipeline, and managed event participant data workflows.

projects.title: InvenSync
projects.desc: Retail point-of-sale cashier and inventory management system backed by Oracle Database 21c with enterprise-grade relational constraints.
projects.contribution: Designed relational schema, PL/SQL functions, sequences, and triggers in Oracle 21c, and built PHP MVC cashier transaction workflows.

projects.title: PickyNet
projects.desc: Decision Support System for Internet Service Provider (ISP) selection implementing the WASPAS (Weight Aggregated Sum Product Assessment) multi-criteria algorithm.
projects.contribution: Implemented mathematical normalization, WSM & WPM ranking calculation engine, ISP parameter management, and interactive comparison UI.

points: Architected scalable web and mobile solutions including PRIME (predictive maintenance monorepo) and Ardana (cooperative finance platform).
Implemented reactive fullstack architectures integrating containerized services, vector databases, and real-time socket communication.
Engineered enterprise inventory and point-of-sale systems (InvenSync) utilizing Oracle Database 21c PL/SQL triggers and sequences.
Built automated webhook payment handling and event management platforms for regional competition registrations (Expasign).
Implemented WASPAS multi-criteria decision support systems for ISP selection with normalized mathematical modeling.
Developed offline high-speed P2P file sharing solutions using Flutter and mDNS local network service discovery (ShareThem).
